sources.entry: nefarious - Automate downloading Movies and TV Shows. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Python

summary.one_liner: nefarious is a self-hosted web application that automatically downloads Movies and TV Shows by using Jackett for torrent searching and Transmission for downloading.
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you search and discover TV shows and movies (by popularity, genre, year and similar), and automatically downloads them when they match your settings. Jackett searches torrent indexers and Transmission handles the downloads, with status monitored from within the app. Quality profiles (for example 1080p movies, 720p TV), user-defined keyword filters, and blacklisting of bad torrents are supported. It can rename media automatically, download subtitles via the OpenSubtitles API, and send notifications through Apprise. It also supports multiple users with permission groups and can import existing libraries.
use_cases: automatically download TV shows as they air
automate movie downloads from torrent indexers
filter torrents by quality or unwanted codecs
share a media downloader with multiple household users
how_to_run: git clone the nefarious repository and cd into it
Log in at the nefarious URL with admin/admin and enter the Jackett API token in settings
notable: Automatically detects and blacklists spam/fake videos and torrents stuck past a set number of days
Quality profiles and hardcoded-subtitle preferences per download
Self-updating application via the default docker-compose setup
Discovery and recommendations via TMDB and Rotten Tomatoes, with movie trailers
caveats: Requires Docker and docker-compose plus separately configured Jackett and Transmission containers
First startup can take several minutes
Low-powered systems such as single board computers need extra setup described in a separate SBC.md file
